title: travelplanner: Could you help develop a week-long travel itinerary suitable for a group of 6 people, departing from Baton Rouge and planning to visit 3 different cities in Texas? The travel dates are set from March 17th to March 23rd, 2022. Our travel budget has been adjusted to $14,600. The travel dates are set from March 17th to March 23rd, 2022. Our travel budget has been adjusted to $14,600. content.content:
We need to produce a week-long travel itinerary (7 days) for 6 people, departing from Baton Rouge, visiting 3 different cities in Texas. Dates March 17-23, 2022. Budget $14,600. Children under ten, need whole rooms, not self-drive (so use flights, possibly trains, buses). Need to generate plan per day using submit_day_plan function. Must not ask follow-up. Need to decide which cities: maybe Houston, Austin, San Antonio. Travel: Baton Rouge to Houston (flight), then Houston to Austin (flight or train), then Austin to San Antonio (train or bus), then back to Baton Rouge (flight from San Antonio). Need accommodations: whole rooms (maybe two 3-bed suites or multiple rooms). Provide restaurants, attractions suitable for kids.

We need to call submit_day_plan for each day (7 days). Provide fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to include transportation details each day. For days staying in same city, transportation could be "Hotel stay, no travel". For travel days, include flight details.

Let's outline:

Day 1: March 17, travel from Baton Rouge to Houston. Flight. Arrival, check into hotel (e.g., "Embassy Suites by Hilton Houston Downtown - Family Suite"). Breakfast maybe in flight or at hotel? Let's set breakfast at "Hotel Continental Breakfast". Attractions: Space Center Houston (but that's in Houston). Could be later. Day 1: after arrival, visit Houston Museum of Natural Science (kid-friendly). Lunch: "The Pit Room, Houston". Dinner: "Pappadeaux Seafood Kitchen, Houston". Accommodation: Embassy Suites.

Day2: March 18, Houston. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: Houston Zoo, Children's Museum of Houston. Lunch: "Nikki's Pizza, Houston". Dinner: "The Breakfast Klub (brunch style)". Accommodation same.

Day3: March 19, travel Houston to Austin. Flight (maybe short flight). Transportation: Flight Number: something. Arrival Austin, check into hotel (e.g., "Hyatt Regency Austin - Family Suite"). Breakfast on flight or at airport. Attractions: Zilker Park and Barton Springs (kids). Lunch: "Kerbey Lane Cafe". Dinner: "Home Slice Pizza". Accommodation.

Day4: March 20, Austin. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: Austin's Thinkery (children's museum), Lady Bird Lake paddle boarding (optional). Lunch: "Franklin Barbecue". Dinner: "The Salt Lick BBQ". Accommodation.

Day5: March 21, travel Austin to San Antonio. Could be train (Amtrak Texas Eagle) or bus. Use train. Transportation: Amtrak Train 21, from Austin to San Antonio. Arrival. Hotel: "Hotel Valencia Riverwalk - Family Suite". Breakfast on train. Attractions: The Alamo, San Antonio River Walk. Lunch: "The River Walk Café". Dinner: "Mi Tierra Café y Restaurante". Accommodation.

Day6: March 22, San Antonio. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: San Antonio Zoo, The Do Seuss Sanctuary (kids). Lunch: "The Pearl - Food Hall". Dinner: "The Granary '87". Accommodation.

Day7: March 23, travel back to Baton Rouge from San Antonio. Flight. Breakfast at hotel. Transportation: Flight Number: ... Arrival Baton Rouge. End.

We need to ensure each day has fields: day (1-7), current_city (or "from A to B" if traveling). transportation: string description. breakfast: string. attraction: string (multiple separated by ;). lunch: string. dinner: string. accommodation: string.

For days with travel, current_city maybe "from Baton Rouge to Houston". Or per spec: "The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B". So day 1: from Baton Rouge to Houston.

Day2: Houston.

Day3: from Houston to Austin.

Day4: Austin.

Day5: from Austin to San Antonio.

Day6: San Antonio.

Day7: from San Antonio to Baton Rouge.

Let's craft transportation details.

Day1 transportation: "Flight Number: UA1234, from Baton Rouge (BTR) to Houston (IAH), Departure Time: 08:00, Arrival Time: 09:30". Use United.

Day3: "Flight Number: AA5678, from Houston (IAH) to Austin (AUS), Departure Time: 10:00, Arrival Time: 10:45".

Day5: "Amtrak Train 21, from Austin to San Antonio, Departure Time: 09:00, Arrival Time: 11:30".

Day7: "Flight Number: DL9012, from San Antonio (SAT) to Baton Rouge (BTR), Departure Time: 12:00, Arrival Time: 13:45".

Accommodations: Use family suites.

Now call submit_day_plan for each day.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
